name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; domain=inventory/equip, descriptor=equip_item_in_slot. Name accurately reflects the behavior: mark the given inventory slot as equipped, auto-unequipping any same-category item first. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Mark inventory slot slot_idx of runtime_char[char_idx] as equipped, first auto-unequipping any already-equipped same-category item (enforcing the one-weapon + one-spellbook mutual-exclusion rule).
logic_summary: rc = data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr. item_id = fd2_get_inventory_slot_item_id(char_idx, slot_idx). Loop scan_iter 0..7 over the 8 inventory slots: if a slot is equipped (flag byte inventory_slots[scan_iter*2] & 0x40) AND it holds a same-category item (both item_id and the slot's item id < 0x80, or both >= 0x80), clear that slot's flag (unequip). After the scan, set inventory_slots[slot_idx*2] = 0x40 to mark the chosen slot equipped. Category split point is item_id 0x80 (0x00..0x7F physical weapons/armor/items, 0x80..0xD6 magical spellbooks).

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr selecting the character whose inventory is modified.
params.reason: Accurately names the runtime_char array index; no address residue.

params.name: slot_idx
params.semantics: Inventory slot index (0..7) to equip; passed to fd2_get_inventory_slot_item_id and used as the final inventory_slots[slot_idx*2] = 0x40 target.
params.reason: Accurately names the inventory slot index being equipped; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; mutates the inventory slot flag bytes in place.
